name: Tri Nguyen Minh
title: Architect · Tinkerer
tagline: I design buildings. I also build tools for designing them.
bioParagraphs: Architect based in Saigon with 8+ years of experience in residential architecture and façade design.
Along the way, I build small web and 3D tools around problems I encounter in practice—making design work clearer, faster, and more interactive.
